subject.title: fix(github-copilot): prevent stale encrypted reasoning failures

question: Should encrypted-replay recovery be consolidated into the shared `packages/ai` Responses lifecycle before this PR merges, or should OpenClaw intentionally maintain separate recovery policies for the managed and `streamSimple` transports?
rationale: Both transports are active and affected, but selecting their permanent recovery owner changes architecture and determines whether https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108462 should be incorporated, superseded, or maintained separately.

options.title: Consolidate shared recovery
options.body: Move or expose one bounded recovery implementation in the shared Responses lifecycle and make both transports use it while retaining Copilot-owned cold sanitation.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Land only the provider-owned Copilot sanitation here and let a separately reviewed shared-transport PR own generic retry behavior.

options.title: Accept split policies
options.body: Keep both transport-specific implementations, with explicit ownership and equivalent retry, output-safety, and live-proof coverage for each.

recommendation.title: Consolidate shared recovery
recommendation.body: Move or expose one bounded recovery implementation in the shared Responses lifecycle and make both transports use it while retaining Copilot-owned cold sanitation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged history ties this person to the shared Responses completion guard and cross-provider stream behavior where the owner decision must be made.
